provenance:saved-cover-current-builder.method: both complete material differences between the saved production STEP and current relaxed-cover builder

fit:industrial-wing-extension.method: Exact lip material equality and translated complete bezel equality against the zero-extension builder; the neck-opening cutter moves by the same local N increment.
fit:industrial-wing-extension.scope: Industrial-only seating trial. Printed fit remains unmeasured.

solid:display-motion-obstacle.method: A valid conservative crop or the complete unchanged source obstacle; no stock is omitted on crop failure

wall:cover-lip--1.method: complete relieved lip and independent central unchamfered-core witnesses, nine exact full-height interior chords per side, and complete curved-root-to-show-skin separation

bearing:display-lip-flat-lands--1.method: exact line intervals on actual planar lip and groove faces at nine S stations per side; upper lip translated to the groove ceiling before comparing its flat overlap
bearing:display-lip-flat-lands--1.scope: CAD bearing lands after inner corner relief; printed edge shape and support-contact finish require the real parts

wall:retention-groove--1.method: complete 2 mm annular witness behind the actual swept groove, including its rear torus section

wall:retention-shoulder--1.method: complete annular volume between the original cylinder and groove-root sweep over a 2 mm N band above each retaining shoulder
wall:retention-shoulder--1.scope: retained stock following the curved neck; not a 2 mm vertical column at every point of the outer bearing edge

snap:engagement--1.method: actual lip and groove cylinder/torus radii and clipped face extents in the display frame

bearing:display-lip-flat-lands-+1.scope: CAD bearing lands after inner corner relief; printed edge shape and support-contact finish require the real parts

wall:retention-shoulder-+1.method: complete annular volume between the original cylinder and groove-root sweep over a 2 mm N band above each retaining shoulder

seat:display-cover.method: exact common volume at the designed lip-floor contact pose

seat:display-cover-stop.method: six independent interior floor witnesses after 0.01 mm inward travel; the complete 0.02 mm contact common must remain in the actual lips against groove floors or preload roots, before the display or glass

retention:display-snaps.scope: geometric cover-lip capture only; the roof allowance is nominal upward travel, not a zero-rattle or retention-force prediction. PET-GF force, flex distribution and cycling require the complete print trial

motion:display-cover-normal.obstacle_crop_method: exact conservative bounds of both complete covers, expanded by the full independent outward search budget in X, all normal lifts in N, and 0.1 mm on every face; also contains the inward seating probes
motion:display-cover-normal.scope: final normal seating of the preloaded cover/display cartridge after the lifted axial approach; display and glass move with the cover. Nominal contact must stay in the lips and lower skirts, or reach no deeper than the graze depth outside them. Each skirt's rigid outward translation measures clearance demand, not deformation, strain, force, or the loaded equilibrium shape of the joined end bridges

clearance:snap-travel-display.method: complete nominal and relaxed covers at every final seating station, plus both states' actual lower skirts at half and full measured outward travel; the display/glass share the cover's normal translation, while tubes and neck ribbon remain fixed; exact commons or distance, with conservative box separation where available

clearance:snap-travel-glass.method: complete nominal and relaxed covers at every final seating station, plus both states' actual lower skirts at half and full measured outward travel; the display/glass share the cover's normal translation, while tubes and neck ribbon remain fixed; exact commons or distance, with conservative box separation where available

clearance:snap-travel-ribbon-neck.method: complete nominal and relaxed covers at every final seating station, plus both states' actual lower skirts at half and full measured outward travel; the display/glass share the cover's normal translation, while tubes and neck ribbon remain fixed; exact commons or distance, with conservative box separation where available

clearance:snap-travel-soda-tube.method: complete nominal and relaxed covers at every final seating station, plus both states' actual lower skirts at half and full measured outward travel; the display/glass share the cover's normal translation, while tubes and neck ribbon remain fixed; exact commons or distance, with conservative box separation where available

clearance:snap-travel-flavor-a.method: complete nominal and relaxed covers at every final seating station, plus both states' actual lower skirts at half and full measured outward travel; the display/glass share the cover's normal translation, while tubes and neck ribbon remain fixed; exact commons or distance, with conservative box separation where available

clearance:snap-travel-flavor-b.method: complete nominal and relaxed covers at every final seating station, plus both states' actual lower skirts at half and full measured outward travel; the display/glass share the cover's normal translation, while tubes and neck ribbon remain fixed; exact commons or distance, with conservative box separation where available

shape:display-rigid-neck.method: complete swept subsurface witness above the grooves, exact exterior endpoints and continuous material on 60 chords, no material beyond the cylinder and named foot pads, and the complete full-width opening above the feet; complete pad/backing volumes are checked separately

motion:display-loading-into-cover.method: exact complete downward projection of every upward device face within the cover band, after verifying all reference surfaces are parallel vertical extrusions; independent actual free-wing translation and exact common/distance
motion:display-loading-into-cover.scope: factory loading opens the plastic before the PCB enters. Opening demand is geometric; the joined end bridges, force, spring return and display support require the complete print trial. This is not an elastic shape prediction

motion:display-cartridge-axial.method: exact containment of every relevant fixed solid inside a straight cylinder, plus exact clearance of each complete lifted mover from that S-invariant cylinder; proves the entire axial segment rather than sampled poses
motion:display-cartridge-axial.scope: display and glass travel inside the cover from the outlet. The temporary flexible ribbon branch must be fed during factory assembly; its final route is checked separately. Normal seating and plastic opening have separate readings

coverage:display-rear-electronics.method: exact +S surface crossings and solid-classified material intervals behind occupied display/component or branch-ribbon sections, through the nominal assembled tip and cover
coverage:display-rear-electronics.scope: sampled rear line-of-sight closure around the actual hardware; stock and rim thickness have separate readings. This is not a water-seal or all-angle visibility certificate

wall:industrial-flanks.method: exact B-rep chords normal to the complete rectangular flank faces and their affine relaxed images
wall:industrial-flanks.scope: 480 named flank sections; the bezel and end walls have separate complete witnesses

wall:industrial-end-walls.method: complete parallel outer/inner end-face distances on both actual solids; X preforming preserves every S coordinate
wall:industrial-end-walls.scope: the remaining front and rear slabs and their neck-opening rims; no cuff

scope: Saved production Industrial cover only against the shared exact tip, device and tubing. Nine explicit normal stations measure geometric outward demand; whole-volume loading and axial cylinder bounds cover their complete strokes. The shared lower base is outside the display motion region. Material behavior, insertion force and retention require the complete Industrial print trial.

retained_measurement_scope.scope: The 45 cover measurements and complete display obstacle remain unchanged. The only executable corrections open donor/lever clearances below CAD Z57.5; the complete tip native STEP DATA and all cover geometry are unchanged.
